current.text: A Pelicans beat reporter reports that Missi is likely to start at center over Derik Queen.
Experts expect him to be the Pelicans' starting center on opening night, ahead of Derik Queen.
Josh sees him as a late flier with upside for two blocks, a high FG% and double-digit rebounds. He is available everywhere.
The Pelicans have a crowded frontcourt with Zion Williamson, Derik Queen and Saddiq Bey. Bey may close games in lineups with Zion at center.
New coach Jamahl Mosley brings a defense-first style and switches less. Less switching could help Missi's defensive rebounding.
Experts see the Pelicans as a weak team near the bottom of the West. Jake predicts about 34 wins.

durable.text: He is a strong rim protector who contests shots at the rim at a high rate. Last season he turned 39% of his rim contests into blocks.
He is a poor defensive rebounder for a center, around the bottom 10% at his position.
Blocks are his standout category, far above the top 250 pool. He makes no threes and gets few steals, even for a center.

tags.detail: About 1.8 blocks projected; high block rate on rim contests

note: Yahoo ranks Missi 143 and ESPN ranks him 164. Both value him at 0 USD, and he went for 2 USD in our league's last auction. With 144 players drafted, he is a 1 to 2 USD end-of-draft flier or a waiver pickup. He fits builds that punt 3PM and STL and want blocks and FG%. Early in the season, check that he starts over Derik Queen and gets more than last season's 19.6 minutes, and how often Zion or Saddiq Bey close games at center.
